text: Mutumin da ya zo jiya malaminmu ne.
gloss: The man who came yesterday is our teacher.

text: Da na sani, da ban zo ba.
gloss: Had I known, I would not have come.

text: Don Allah ka taimake ni.
gloss: Please help me.

text: Duk da haka, gwamnati ta ce za ta ci gaba da shirin.
gloss: Even so, the government said it will continue with the plan.

text: Manoma kan yi noma da safe.
gloss: Farmers usually farm in the morning.

text: A ganina, ilimi kyauta ya taimaka wa yara da yawa.
gloss: In my view, free education has helped many children.

text: Ban tsammani wannan shiri zai yi nasara ba tare da goyon bayan jama'a ba.
gloss: I don't think this plan will succeed without public support.

text: Na yarda da kai kaɗan, amma ba gaba ɗaya ba.
gloss: I agree with you a little, but not entirely.

text: Da alama farashin abinci zai ci gaba da hauhawa bana.
gloss: It seems food prices will keep rising this year.

text: Yana da muhimmanci a saurari ɓangarorin biyu kafin a yanke shawara.
gloss: It is important to hear both sides before deciding.

text: Ina ganin ya kamata a ba matasa ƙarin dama a shugabanci.
gloss: I think young people should be given more opportunity in leadership.

text: Ɗalibin da ya ci kyauta ƙanina ne.
gloss: The student who won the prize is my younger brother.

text: Gidan da muka gina bara an sayar da shi.
gloss: The house we built last year has been sold.

text: Mutanen da suke zaune a birni suna biyan kuɗin haya mai yawa.
gloss: People who live in the city pay a lot of rent.

text: Littafin da ka ara min yana da daɗin karatu.
gloss: The book you lent me is pleasant to read.

text: Wurin da muka haɗu karo na farko ya canza.
gloss: The place where we first met has changed.

text: Malamin da yake koya mana lissafi yana da tsauri.
gloss: The teacher who teaches us maths is strict.

text: Idan ka zo da wuri, za mu tafi tare.
gloss: If you come early, we will go together.

text: Da ina da kuɗi, da na sayi gona.
gloss: If I had money, I would have bought a farm.

text: Idan aka yi ruwan sama yau, za a ɗage taron.
gloss: If it rains today, the meeting will be postponed.

text: Idan ba ka ci abinci da kyau ba, za ka raunana.
gloss: If you don't eat well, you will become weak.

text: Da na isa, sun riga sun tafi.
gloss: When I arrived, they had already left.

text: Yana karatu lokacin da wuta ta ɗauke.
gloss: He was reading when the power went off.

text: Har yanzu bai iso gida ba.
gloss: He hasn't reached home yet.

text: Ban taɓa zuwa Kano ba.
gloss: I have never been to Kano.

text: Dattawa kan zauna ƙarƙashin wannan bishiya da yamma.
gloss: Elders usually sit under this tree in the evening.

text: Da farko, bari mu duba matsalar kanta.
gloss: First, let us look at the problem itself.

text: Bugu da ƙari, kuɗin mota ya ƙaru.
gloss: Moreover, transport fares have increased.

text: Saboda haka, muna buƙatar sabon tsari.
gloss: Therefore, we need a new plan.

text: Misali, makarantu da yawa ba su da ɗakin karatu.
gloss: For example, many schools have no library.

text: A gefe guda kuma, iyaye ma suna da nauyi.
gloss: On the other hand, parents also have a responsibility.

text: A ƙarshe, taron ya ƙare lafiya.
gloss: Finally, the meeting ended peacefully.

text: Don Allah ka yi haƙuri da jinkirin da na yi.
gloss: Please excuse my lateness.

text: Ko za ka taimaka min in ɗauki wannan kaya?
gloss: Could you help me carry this load?

text: Barka da zuwa, ka ji kamar a gida kake.
gloss: Welcome, feel at home.

text: Allah ya jiƙan sa, Allah ya ba ku haƙuri.
gloss: May God have mercy on him and grant you patience.

text: Na gode da karamcinku.
gloss: Thank you for your generosity.

text: Ranka ya daɗe, ina neman izinin tafiya.
gloss: Long live you (sir), I seek permission to leave.

text: Ina neman aikin da aka tallata a jarida.
gloss: I am seeking the job advertised in the newspaper.

text: Ina da ƙwarewar shekara biyar a fannin lissafin kuɗi.
gloss: I have five years' experience in accounting.

text: Albashina bai isa in biya duk buƙatuna ba.
gloss: My salary is not enough to meet all my needs.

text: Ina fama da zazzaɓi tun jiya da dare.
gloss: I have had a fever since last night.

text: Sauro ne ke yaɗa cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
gloss: Mosquitoes spread malaria.

text: Duk yara ya kamata a yi musu allurar rigakafi.
gloss: All children should be vaccinated.

text: Sare itatuwa ya haifar da fari a wannan yanki.
gloss: Tree felling has caused drought in this area.

text: Ambaliyar ruwa ta lalata gonaki da yawa bana.
gloss: Floods destroyed many farms this year.

text: Wata rana, wani maharbi ya tafi daji shi kaɗai.
gloss: One day, a hunter went to the bush alone.

text: Kwatsam, sai ya ji wata murya mai ban mamaki.
gloss: Suddenly, he heard a strange voice.

text: Ya yi ƙoƙarin komawa gida amma ya ɓata.
gloss: He tried to go home but got lost.

text: A ƙarshe, mutanen ƙauye suka same shi.
gloss: In the end, the villagers found him.

text: Ana gaishe da dattijo da girmamawa, sau da yawa ana durƙusawa.
gloss: Elders are greeted respectfully, often by kneeling or crouching.

text: Ba a karɓar abu daga babba da hannun hagu.
gloss: One does not receive something from an elder with the left hand.

text: Ana raɗin suna a rana ta bakwai bayan haihuwa.
gloss: The naming ceremony is held on the seventh day after birth.

text: Kunya da kara suna da muhimmanci a al'adar Hausawa.
gloss: Modesty and respect are important in Hausa culture.

text: Ya sha jinin jikinsa.
gloss: He was terrified.

text: Ya ci kasuwa.
gloss: He did well (lit. he ate the market).

text: Ta yi kunnen uwar shegu.
gloss: She turned a deaf ear.

text: Ko da yake tattalin arziki ya bunkasa, har yanzu talakawa da yawa suna fama da talauci.
gloss: Although the economy has grown, many ordinary people still struggle with poverty.

text: Da ya isa gida, sai ya ga kofa a bude.
gloss: When he reached home, he saw the door open.

text: Sannu da zuwa.
gloss: Welcome.

text: Komai nisan jifa dole zai fado kasa
gloss: However far a stone is thrown, it must fall to earth.

text: ruwa baya tsami banza
gloss: Water does not go sour for nothing.

text: Ko da yake shirin yana da kyakkyawar manufa, aiwatar da shi ya yi rauni.
gloss: Although the plan has good intentions, its implementation has been weak.

text: A bayyane yake cewa ba tare da ilimi ba, ci gaba ba zai yiwu ba.
gloss: It is clear that without education, progress is impossible.

text: Tambayar ba ita ce ko muna buƙatar sauyi ba, a'a, yaya za mu kawo shi.
gloss: The question is not whether we need change, but how to bring it.

text: Idan gwamnati ta kasa magance cin hanci, jama'a za su daina amincewa da ita.
gloss: If the government fails to tackle bribery, people will stop trusting it.

text: Duk da ƙoƙarin da aka yi, sakamakon bai gamsar ba tukuna.
gloss: Despite the efforts made, the results are not yet satisfactory.

text: Yawan karatunka, yawan fahimtarka.
gloss: The more you read, the more you understand.

text: Dole mu tafi kafin ruwa ya fara.
gloss: We must leave before the rain starts.

text: Ana cewa ɗan siyasar zai yi murabus.
gloss: It is said the politician will resign.

text: Babu wanda ya san abin da ya faru.
gloss: No one knew what had happened.

text: Yana magana kamar shi masani ne.
gloss: He talks as if he were an expert.

text: Cikin girmamawa, ina gabatar da roƙona gare ku.
gloss: Respectfully, I present my request to you.

text: Muna sanar da ku cewa za a rufe ofis ranar Litinin.
gloss: We inform you that the office will be closed on Monday.

text: A madadin kwamiti, ina miƙa godiya ta musamman.
gloss: On behalf of the committee, I extend special thanks.

text: A daren nan, ƙauyen gaba ɗaya ya yi tsit.
gloss: That night, the whole village was silent.

text: Tsohon ya zauna a zaure yana tunanin ƙuruciyarsa.
gloss: The old man sat in the entrance hut thinking of his youth.

text: Ya gane cewa dukiya ba ta iya sayen lokacin da ya wuce.
gloss: He realised wealth cannot buy time that has passed.

text: Karin magana ana amfani da shi wajen ba da shawara ba tare da ɓata wa mutum rai ba.
gloss: Proverbs are used to advise without offending.

text: Fadar sarki muhimmiyar cibiya ce ta al'ada a ƙasar Hausa.
gloss: The emir's palace is an important cultural centre in Hausaland.

text: Hawan Sallah biki ne na dawakai a lokacin Sallah.
gloss: Hawan Sallah is a horse festival during the Eid celebrations.

text: Sannu sannu bai hana zuwa.
gloss: Slowly, slowly does not prevent arrival.

text: Haƙuri maganin duniya.
gloss: Patience is the cure for the world's troubles.

text: Hannu ɗaya ba ya ɗaukar jinka.
gloss: One hand cannot lift a thatch roof.

text: Babu shakka wannan batu yana bukatar zurfafa tattaunawa.
gloss: Without doubt this issue needs deeper discussion.

text: Babu shakka makomar ƙasa ta dogara ne ga ingancin ilimin da ake bayarwa a yau.
gloss: Undoubtedly, the nation's future depends on the quality of education given today.

text: 'Yancin faɗar albarkacin baki ba shi da ma'ana idan jama'a suna tsoron magana.
gloss: Freedom of speech is meaningless if people fear to speak.

text: Idan ba mu koyi darasi daga tarihi ba, za mu maimaita kurakurai iri ɗaya.
gloss: If we don't learn from history, we will repeat the same mistakes.

text: Mawaƙin ya yi amfani da kogi a matsayin alamar rayuwa mai sauyawa.
gloss: The poet used the river as a symbol of changing life.

text: Rikici tsakanin al'ada da zamani shi ne jigon labarin.
gloss: The conflict between tradition and modernity is the story's theme.

text: Bisa sashe na biyar na wannan doka, hukumar tana da ikon bincike.
gloss: Under section five of this law, the authority has the power to inspect.

text: Wanda ake tuhuma ya musanta dukkan tuhume-tuhumen.
gloss: The accused denied all the charges.

text: Waƙoƙin baka na Hausa suna adana tarihin al'umma.
gloss: Hausa oral songs preserve the community's history.

text: Rashin sani ya fi dare duhu.
gloss: Ignorance is darker than night.

text: Zomo ba ya kamuwa daga zaune.
gloss: A hare is not caught while sitting.

text: Nwoke ahụ m hụrụ ụnyaahụ bụ onye nkuzi anyị.
gloss: The man I saw yesterday is our teacher.

text: Ọ bụrụ na mmiri ezo, anyị agaghị aga.
gloss: If it rains, we will not go.

text: Biko nyere m aka.
gloss: Please help me.

text: Otú ọ dị, gọọmentị kwuru na ha ga-aga n'ihu.
gloss: However, the government said they will continue.

text: O were akwụkwọ ahụ bịa.
gloss: He brought that book.

text: N'uche m, agụmakwụkwọ n'efu enyerela ọtụtụ ụmụaka aka.
gloss: In my view, free education has helped many children.

text: Echeghị m na atụmatụ a ga-aga nke ọma ma ọ bụrụ na ndị mmadụ akwadoghị ya.
gloss: I don't think this plan will succeed if the people don't support it.

text: Ekwenyere m gị ntakịrị, mana ọ bụghị kpam kpam.
gloss: I agree with you a little, but not completely.

text: Ọ dị ka ọnụ ahịa nri ga-aga n'ihu na-arị elu n'afọ a.
gloss: It seems food prices will keep rising this year.

text: Ọ dị mkpa ịnụ akụkụ abụọ tupu e kpebie.
gloss: It is important to hear both sides before deciding.

text: Nwata akwụkwọ nke meriri ihe nrite bụ nwanne m nwanyị.
gloss: The student who won the prize is my sister.

text: Ụlọ anyị wuru n'afọ gara aga ka erela.
gloss: The house we built last year has been sold.

text: Ndị bi n'obodo mepere emepe na-akwụ ụgwọ ụlọ dị elu.
gloss: People who live in the city pay high rent.

text: Akwụkwọ ị gbaziri m na-atọ ụtọ ịgụ.
gloss: The book you lent me is enjoyable to read.

text: Onye nkuzi na-akụziri anyị mgbakọ na mwepụ siri ike.
gloss: The teacher who teaches us maths is strict.

text: Ọ bụrụ na ị bịa n'oge, anyị ga-eso aga.
gloss: If you come early, we will go together.

text: A sị na m nwere ego, m gaara azụta ala.
gloss: If I had money, I would have bought land.

text: Ọ bụrụ na i righị nri nke ọma, ị ga-ada mba.
gloss: If you don't eat well, you will become weak.

text: Mgbe m rutere, ha apụọla.
gloss: When I arrived, they had left.

text: Ọ na-agụ akwụkwọ mgbe ọkụ latara.
gloss: He was reading when the light went off.

text: Ọ bịabeghị n'ụlọ.
gloss: He hasn't come home yet.

text: Agabeghị m Enugwu.
gloss: I have never been to Enugu.

text: Nke mbụ, ka anyị lee nsogbu ahụ anya.
gloss: First, let us look at the problem.

text: Ọzọkwa, ego ụgbọ ala arịgoola.
gloss: Moreover, transport fares have risen.

text: N'ihi ya, anyị chọrọ atụmatụ ọhụrụ.
gloss: Therefore, we need a new plan.

text: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọtụtụ ụlọ akwụkwọ enweghị ọba akwụkwọ.
gloss: For example, many schools have no library.

text: N'ikpeazụ, nzukọ ahụ biri n'udo.
gloss: Finally, the meeting ended peacefully.

text: Biko, gbaghara m maka ịbịa n'azụ oge.
gloss: Please forgive me for coming late.

text: Ị nwere ike inyere m aka bulie ibu a?
gloss: Can you help me carry this load?

text: Nnọọ, mee ka ọ dị gị ka ọ bụ n'ụlọ gị.
gloss: Welcome, make yourself at home.

text: Daalụ maka ọbịbịa gị.
gloss: Thank you for your visit.

text: Ndo maka ọnwụ nke nna gị.
gloss: Sorry for the death of your father.

text: Achọrọ m ọrụ e boro n'akwụkwọ akụkọ.
gloss: I want the job advertised in the newspaper.

text: Ụgwọ ọnwa m ezughị ịkwụ ụgwọ niile.
gloss: My monthly pay is not enough to pay all the bills.

text: Ahụ ọkụ na-eme m kemgbe ụnyaahụ.
gloss: I have had a fever since yesterday.

text: Anwụnta na-ebute ịba.
gloss: Mosquitoes cause malaria.

text: Otu ụbọchị, otu dinta gara n'ọhịa naanị ya.
gloss: One day, a hunter went to the forest alone.

text: Na mberede, ọ nụrụ olu dị iche.
gloss: Suddenly, he heard a strange voice.

text: N'ikpeazụ, ndị obodo hụrụ ya.
gloss: In the end, the villagers found him.

text: Ọjị bụ ihe mbụ a na-enye ọbịa n'ala Igbo.
gloss: Kola nut is the first thing offered to a guest in Igboland.

text: Onye kacha okenye na-agọzi ọjị tupu a nyawaa ya.
gloss: The eldest person blesses the kola before it is broken.

text: A naghị eji aka ekpe anara okenye ihe.
gloss: One does not receive things from an elder with the left hand.

text: Iri ji ọhụrụ bụ mmemme ekele maka owuwe ihe ubi.
gloss: The New Yam festival is a thanksgiving for the harvest.

text: Obi ya dị ọcha.
gloss: He is sincere (lit. his heart is clean).

text: Ọ gbara ọsọ ndụ.
gloss: He ran for his life.

text: Mgbe o ruru n'ụlọ, ọ hụrụ na ụzọ mepere emepe.
gloss: When he reached home, he saw the door was open.

text: Ọjị bụ ihe dị mkpa n'omenala Igbo.
gloss: Kola nut is important in Igbo custom.

text: Egbe bere, ugo bere
gloss: Let the kite perch and let the eagle perch.

text: Ọ bụ ezie na atụmatụ ahụ dị mma, mmejuputa ya adịghị ike.
gloss: Although the plan is good, its implementation is weak.

text: O doro anya na enweghị agụmakwụkwọ, ọganihu agaghị ekwe omume.
gloss: Clearly, without education, progress is impossible.

text: Ọ bụrụ na gọọmentị emeghị ihe gbasara nrụrụaka, ndị mmadụ agaghị atụkwasị ya obi.
gloss: If the government does nothing about corruption, people will not trust it.

text: Ka ị na-agụkwu akwụkwọ, ka ị na-aghọtakwu ihe.
gloss: The more you read, the more you understand.

text: Ọ dịghị onye maara ihe mere.
gloss: No one knew what happened.

text: Ọ na-ekwu okwu ka à ga-asị na ọ bụ ọkachamara.
gloss: He speaks as if he were an expert.

text: N'aha kọmitii, ana m ekele unu nke ukwuu.
gloss: On behalf of the committee, I thank you greatly.
